The '''Lance Squadron''' was a [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] of [[Aurek-class tactical strikefighter|''Aurek''-class tactical strikefighters]] during the [[Mandalorian Wars]].

==History==
The squadron was under the command of [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Carth Onasi]] in the service of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Mandalorian Wars]]. In [[3963 BBY]], it was assigned to intercept [[Zayne Carrick]] before he could arrive at [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].
